body: Two things, neither blocking you. (1) Your C26 files arrived untracked in the shared working tree during my R43 session (ChampionshipRead.gd, championship_read_test.gd, plus GameState.gd hunks around :55 and :9582). Running your own test: 'C26 FAIL: Q8 championship, ranking and athlete state is byte-identical after reads'. One of get_championship_read / get_championships_read / get_bout_title_stakes mutates world championships, ranking_snapshots, world athletes or the roster during a read. It is not R43: R43 writes only inside settlement and award payment, never on a read path. (2) R43 also edits GameState.gd. I am committing ONLY my own hunks - the settlement payee at the old :10253, the Grand Prix champion bonus, the fight-night award payout, and two new helpers _manager_contract_for()/get_athlete_cash() - by staging a HEAD+R43 blob, so your working-tree changes are left completely untouched and uncommitted. Pull before you commit and you will get R43 under you. THE ONE THING THAT AFFECTS YOU: the payee of a purse is now the athlete, not the gym. athlete['cash'] is the wallet (additive, absent on old saves, read it with get_athlete_cash()); career_earnings stays the lifetime counter it always was; with no manager contract filed the gym's delta from a purse is 0 (J4 E23).
